mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_agent_tool_permission WHERE del_flag = 0 AND agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM ai_agent_tool_permission WHERE del_flag = 0 AND agent_id = #{agentId} AND tool_key = #{toolKey} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN '__unconfigured__' ELSE CONCAT('configured:', COALESCE(p.decision, '')) END FROM ai_agent a JOIN ai_chat_session s ON s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.status = '0' LEFT JOIN ai_agent_tool_permission p ON p.agent_id = a.id AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.tool_key = #{toolKey} AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE a.id = #{agentId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = 0 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_tool_config c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.agent_id = a.id AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.enabled = '1' AND c.tool_source = #{toolSource} AND c.tool_key = #{toolKey}) OR (#{toolSource} = 'builtin' AND #{toolKey} = 'rag_search' AND a.knowledge_ids IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.knowledge_ids) NOT IN ('', '[]', 'null') AND (a.rag_mode IS NULL OR a.rag_mode != 'none')) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_tool_config other_tool WHERE other_tool.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND other_tool.agent_id = a.id AND other_tool.del_flag = 0 AND other_tool.enabled = '1' AND other_tool.tool_key = #{toolKey} AND other_tool.tool_source != #{toolSource})
